people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

translations.web: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
translations.bsb: Abimelech replied, “I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.”
translations.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
translations.asv: And Abimelech said, I know not who hath done this thing. Neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.
